result.quote: “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him
result.reason: The key is supported, but the broad wording asks generally what the prophet said about the man of God. He also said that the LORD delivered him to the lion and that it mauled and killed him, so materially different answers are defensible. The edit also changes the prepared question’s scope from explaining the man’s death to merely reporting something said about him.
